description: Restore workspace state from a snapshot. The mode ceiling and member roles are restored; the rollback is appended to the audit log rather than rewriting it.

reason.description: Why the rollback was performed. The rollback is itself an audit entry; earlier entries are not rewritten.

to_snapshot_artefact_id.description: Artefact id returned by chap.control.snapshot. An id with no matching snapshot is refused with -32062.

what_to_restore.description: Which captured aspects to apply. Only 'mode_ceiling' and 'members' are restored; the others are held in the snapshot and not reapplied. Restoring members resets role and scopes on members still present, and does not re-add members who have left. Defaults to the snapshot's include list.

name: chap.control.rollback
title: chap.control.rollback
